name: KM3NeT Collaboration
notes: Membership counts intentionally left null: the only figure found on the collaboration's own pages (about-km3net/, about-km3net/collaboration/, about-km3net/collaboration/members/, about-km3net/collaboration/organization/, about-km3net/impact/; checked 2026-09-17) is the qualitative phrase 'hundreds of scientists, engineers, technicians worldwide' (About KM3NeT — Collaboration page), with no precise institute/country/scientist counts and no as-of date. Widely circulated figures such as '68 institutions from 21 countries' / '~360 scientists' appeared only in search-engine summaries and were never confirmed on a page of km3net.org, so only counts stated on the collaboration's own pages would be recorded.
No institution-level member list is recorded in the Atlas for this collaboration.
No leadership list is recorded in the Atlas for this collaboration; no leadership names or dates were found in the sources consulted (checked 2026-09-17).

summary.plain: The international group of scientists and engineers who build and run the KM3NeT neutrino telescopes in the Mediterranean Sea.
summary.technical: KM3NeT Collaboration: international collaboration operating the KM3NeT deep-sea neutrino research infrastructure (ARCA and ORCA); described on its own site only as 'hundreds of scientists, engineers, technicians worldwide', with no precise, dated institute/country/member counts found on an official page. Its legal entity, KM3NeT AISBL, became operational in 2026.
